head: Impressionism
description: A 19th-century art movement characterized by small, thin brush strokes and an emphasis on light and movement.

head: Surrealism
description: An artistic style focusing on the imaginative and the subconscious, often featuring dream-like scenes and unexpected juxtapositions.

head: Cubism
description: An early 20th-century art movement pioneered by Picasso and Braque, using geometric shapes to represent forms from multiple perspectives.

head: Abstract Expressionism
description: A post-World War II art movement in America focused on spontaneous, automatic, or subconscious creation, often with bold colors and gestures.

head: Renaissance Art
description: An era from the 14th to the 17th century known for its focus on classical techniques, realism, and humanism, exemplified by artists like Leonardo da Vinci and Michelangelo.

head: Pop Art
description: A 20th-century art movement drawing from popular and commercial culture, featuring bold colors and images of mass-media objects, led by artists like Andy Warhol.
